note: THE CANONICAL A04 RENDERING FIXTURE. Christian: "use the exact A04 concrete game from this closure run as the canonical rendering fixture. For this first test, do not reselect or re-realize it." So rendering reads THIS artifact and never a fresh run. Regenerated by `npm run freeze:a04` only when the chain itself is corrected — as on 1 October 2026, when the derived roster was found never to reach the concrete game — and never hand-edited. If a run would otherwise produce a different game, that is a separate finding and this file does not move.

along.asAuthored: attacking end (of the team J3 names for the objective referencing it; EACH_TEAM if shared): touches an end line, not the interior
along.why: the prose test is "touches the end line T attacks", which fixes one edge and states no depth The element's noun gives it extent in one dimension and its other axis carries that extent, so its extent on this axis is zero.

across.asAuthored: extends across the axis: the target lies across the direction of progression
across.why: An element spanning the whole of an axis, which is what "end line to end line" and "extends across the axis" both state. Axis-free, so one term serves both. APPROVED by Christian 1 October as a canonical addition to RC-21; no parallel spatial representation is kept beside it.

instantiations.because: GF2-14.a asserts at least two teams exist and individuates none, so two members are instantiated to meet its cardinality. NO PROPERTY IS SUPPLIED: the previous `designation` values ATTACKING_TEAM / DEFENDING_TEAM were removed on Christian's ruling of 2 October as unsupported and unregistered content -- there is no register row for performers.teams[].designation, the stated reasons were positional ("first of the two"), and ATTACKING_TEAM is defined by canonical knowledge as the team CURRENTLY IN POSSESSION, which a static label cannot carry. No replacement is inferred.
